home.headline: Practise the call you'd rather not take.
home.lede: Talk it through out loud with an AI character built from checked research. Then two AI judges show you what landed, tied to the moment it happened.
home.noCalls: You haven't taken a call yet. Two AI judges read each call and give you feedback tied to the moment it happened.
home.trust: Why you can trust the feedback

research.title: Research first
research.text: Agents look for how experts handle the conversation and how people learn it, then check each source.

nothing.title: Nothing guessed
nothing.text: Every rubric line cites its source. What the research can't answer is put to your training lead.

real.title: A real conversation
real.text: You talk out loud to an AI character whose mood moves with what you say.

judges.title: Two judges
judges.text: Each scores the call on their own. A line counts only when both agree, and a disagreement stays on show.

card.written: The character is written once the research is done.

roleplays.headline: Role-play built on research, not guesswork
roleplays.subtitle: Each one was made by the same research pipeline. Start a call in one click.

builder.title: What should your people practise?
builder.placeholder: Describe the conversation that goes wrong, and for whom...
builder.aria: What is going wrong, and for whom?
builder.fileUnreadable: That file could not be read.
builder.fileFailed: That file could not be uploaded. Please try again.
builder.note: Research takes about a minute. You can attach a .txt, .md, .eml or .pdf up to 2 MB. Other people can't open your files. The AI reads them to build the programme, and learners may see short quotes in their feedback.

outage.label: Outage call
outage.text: When production goes down, our engineers call the client and it gets worse. They over-explain the technical cause, never say sorry, and can't give a time for the next update.

sales.label: Sales onboarding
sales.text: New sales reps start demoing features in the first minute of discovery calls and fold at the first price objection.

service.label: Customer service
service.text: Call-centre staff read the refund policy like a robot when customers complain about a refused refund or a double charge.

partner.label: Partner certification
partner.text: Reseller partners misquote our pricing and promise features we don't have when they pitch our cloud backup product.

hard.label: Hard conversations
hard.text: Our new engineering managers avoid hard conversations. When a senior engineer keeps missing code review deadlines and gets defensive, they say nothing or make it personal.

regulated.label: Regulated messaging
regulated.text: Our medical reps go beyond the approved wording when a doctor pushes back on a claim.

read.title: Reads your request
read.text: Works out the situation and who it is for.

find.title: Finds the evidence
find.text: Searches how experts handle it and how people learn it, and checks each source. You watch it happen.

build.title: Builds the programme
build.text: A character, levels and a rubric. Every line cites its source.

ask.title: Asks, never guesses
ask.text: If research can't answer something, you get the question.

account.title: Account
account.workspaceText: There is no login. Your programmes, calls and files are tied to this browser. Your training lead can see your name and results in the team report. Clearing your browser data loses access to them.
account.languageText: Buttons, labels and verdicts use this language. A programme's own content stays in the language it was built in.
